Hormes listens so you can talk to it. Audio goes to the voice model only while a session is open; asleep, nothing leaves this Mac.
Hormes listens for its wake word with on-device speech recognition while it is asleep. Nothing is sent anywhere until you wake Hormes.
Hormes drives other apps to do what you ask: the browser, Finder, System Events. Only while you are talking to it.
Hormes looks through the camera only when you ask it to. Nothing is recorded or kept.
Hormes reads Contacts only when you ask for a name or an address.
Hormes reads and adds calendar events when you ask. Nothing is synced anywhere else.
Hormes reads and adds reminders when you ask.
Hormes finds devices and servers on your network when you ask it to reach one.
Hormes reads and writes files on your Desktop when you ask.
Hormes reads and writes files in Documents when you ask.
Hormes reads and writes files in Downloads when you ask.
Hormes reaches files on network volumes when you ask.
Hormes reaches files on external drives when you ask.
